name: Tuscan Panzanella Salad with White Beans

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the garlic, add olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 6-mm-thick pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallots; peel and halve the shallots lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl.
Large dice the mozzarella into 2-cm cubes and add to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Large dice the buns or rolls into 2-cm cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add the bread cubes and cook, stirring frequently, until toasted and browned, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Once the bread has been transferred, add the beans to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the beans and bread cubes to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
